thread:
priya: Quick sync: product wants to surface a deprecation beacon in console for v1 sunset. Thinking through risk of noisy alerts and tenant confusion. Ideas?
jon: we should gate by traffic percentage to legacy endpoints, not just any v1 hit. e.g. show beacon if >5% of requests in 24h are v1.
marco: agree. also include a per-route impact estimate so infra teams can triage (latency delta, token-count delta).
emily: UX note: beacon should link to a migration checklist and an automated client-compat test runner. we have a simple SDK check that simulates header handshake.
priya: good. what about grace period semantics? product wants a visible countdown. ops concerns about fiddly clocks across regions.
kevin: prefer server-side countdown anchored to tenant's first high-volume v1 event. store a single epoch per tenant to avoid region drift.
on: ops-bot: rolling-canary: deprec-beacon -> 0.5% -> scheduled Thu 14:00 UTC
marco: on telemetry, we need an entropy-safe signal: combine X-Client-Version + route-cookie-presence + response-code-series. That gives us a high precision detection of client fallback.
emily: low overhead approach: sample 0.25% of requests and attach a small tag in traces, then extrapolate. avoids perf hit.
priya: console copy: short + action-oriented. Draft: "Deprecated API usage detected. Migrate to v2 to avoid disruption. Run compatibility test or enable soft-redirects." Thoughts?
jon: reword to avoid panic: "Legacy API activity detected. Review migration steps; consider enabling gradual redirecting to v2."
marco: redirecting — we discussed auto-redirects for tenants that enable an opt-in flag. Implementation question: should redirect be 307 with body or proxy-level route rewrite? 307 preserves method; safer.
kevin: proxy-level rewrite is easier for telemetry and will keep affinity cookie semantics. but must ensure we don't break signed payloads. need a test matrix.
emily: add to plan: 1) detection + beacon 2) console CTA to run compatibility test 3) opt-in soft-redirect 4) telemetry alerts if opt-in causes >1% error delta
priya: quotas: do we show estimated cost delta if tenant migrates? product wants to advertise potential savings. we can compute token-based delta but risk being misleading.
jon: show low-fidelity estimate with a disclaimer. formula: est_savings = current_v1_tokens * (v1_cost_rate - v2_cost_rate) * adoption_factor. simple.
marco: also add a rollback affordance in console for soft-redirects: one-click disable + auto-backfill of previous cookie state.
priya: rollout plan: canary detection change + sampling probe within 48h, beacon UI in next sprint, soft-redirect alpha for 5 tenants after signoff.
on: ops-bot: task-created: telemetry-sample-probe #4521 assigned to marco
emily: one more thing: telemetry retention for this signal should be 90 days to track slow migration cohorts.
kevin: agree. add a dashboard card "v1 cohorts by migration progress" under Routing -> Versioning.
priya: ok team. mari, can you take the UI copy and flow? (cc @emily for the tests)
emarco: pinged mari separately. thanks all.
